title: Spanish police: 128 arrested overnight in Barcelona for ‘looting’

blocks.text: MADRID — Police made 128 arrests overnight in Barcelona for acts of “vandalism”, damage to public property” and “looting”, the regional Catalan police said on Sunday. Seventy-three of those arrested were minors, with the reports due to be sent “to the juvenile prosecutor’s office”, Catalan police chief Silvia Cata told Spain’s 3CatInfo media outlet. Footage
